$comment: Sanitized, illustrative record. Identifiers, amounts and digests are synthetic. One turn in which the actor crossed its delegated authority, the control plane blocked the operation, and no external effect occurred — three facts preserved separately. Shapes follow spec/provider-enforcement-witness-v1.md.

runtimeProvenance.caveat: Authentication proves control of this identity, not that the declared model produced the action.

velvtAdjudication.reason: Amount 5000 exceeds the grant limit of 500 and beneficiary BEN-OTHER-9 is not in the allow list. Neither constraint is satisfied.

providerControl.$note: ACS v0.1.0 decision DENY mapped to disposition BLOCKED. The ACS decision carried policy_references and cited_provenance_ids; only a single policy revision and reason code survive the v1.0 witness shape. See the ACS mapping document for the two representation gaps this exposes.

effect.observationSource: provider settlement API, no matching transaction

interpretation.summary: The actor selected an operation outside its active grant. The control plane blocked it. No external effect occurred.
interpretation.whyBothFactsMatter: An enforcement-only record reports this run identically to one in which the actor never attempted the transfer. The two cases warrant opposite decisions about widening this actor's authority.
limitations: Evidence from one run under one authority boundary and one set of conditions.
Self-asserted identity and model claims remain self-asserted unless independently verified.
Containment by the control plane is not evidence about the actor, and this record does not treat it as such.

integrity.note: Source evidence and derived adjudication are digested separately so the derivation can be re-run against the frozen source. Replay re-derives the adjudication; it does not reproduce the actor's behaviour.
